Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
I play invitation accepted with my ventrue. it passes, they then clan
impersonate to Settite, do they remain Camarilla?

Invitation Accepted
Type: Political Action
If this referendum is successful, each Follower of Set may choose to
become Camarilla. Put this card into play. Whenever a Follower of Set
enters play, he or she may choose to become Camarilla. The Followers
of Set clan is a Camarilla clan.

Clan Impersonation
Type: Action
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
Choose a clan and put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire is
considered to be of the chosen clan instead of his or her original
clan (if any). This vampire can burn this card as an action.

Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:
On 27 août, 15:17, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I play invitation accepted with my ventrue. it passes, they then clan
> impersonate to Settite, do they remain Camarilla?
>

Who is "they' ? And why "remain"?

Any vampire that play CI to become Followers of Set takes the default
sect of the clan, which is now Camarilla.

Messages.Author: wumpus
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

On Aug 27, 6:17 am, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I play invitation accepted with my ventrue. it passes, they then clan
> impersonate to Settite, do they remain Camarilla?

Previous respondents have asserted that Invitation Accepted changes
the default sect for Followers of Set from Independent to Camarilla,
but that's not what it looks like to me. Card text on the Invitation
appears to simply give each Follower a chance to change sects either
a) upon the success of the referendum, or b) upon entering play. When
your Ventrue CI to FoS (after the referendum, so no 'a' case), they
are not entering play (case 'b'), so I suspect that they take the
default sect: Independent.

> Invitation Accepted
> Type: Political Action
> If this referendum is successful, each Follower of Set may choose to
> become Camarilla. Put this card into play. Whenever a Follower of Set
> enters play, he or she may choose to become Camarilla. The Followers
> of Set clan is a Camarilla clan.
>
> Clan Impersonation
> Type: Action
> Cost: 2 blood
> +1 stealth action.
> Choose a clan and put this card on the acting vampire. This vampire is
> considered to be of the chosen clan instead of his or her original
> clan (if any). This vampire can burn this card as an action.

Hope that helps,
Alex

Camarilla, as usual for Ventrue. He or she (VampX) then Clan

Correct.
